name: ecorex-desktop
description: EcoreX desktop application with a local agent runtime
author: EcoreX

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run build:electron && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run stage:runtime:win && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run stage:runtime:win:x64 && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win:x64:signed: npm run build && npm run stage:runtime:win:x64 && electron-builder --win --dir --x64 --publish never && npm run sign:win:unpacked:skip-provider && npm run sign:win:nsis-helper:skip-provider && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --prepackaged release/win-unpacked --publish never && npm run sign:win:setup:skip-provider && npm run update-feed:win -- --arch x64
scripts.package:win:ia32:signed: npm run build && npm run stage:runtime:win:ia32 && electron-builder --win --dir --ia32 --publish never && npm run sign:win:unpacked:ia32:skip-provider && npm run sign:win:nsis-helper:skip-provider && electron-builder --win nsis --ia32 --prepackaged release/win-ia32-unpacked --publish never && npm run sign:win:setup:skip-provider && npm run update-feed:win -- --arch ia32
scripts.package:win:all:signed: npm run package:win:x64:signed && npm run package:win:ia32:signed
scripts.package:mac:all: npm run package:mac:arm64 && npm run package:mac:x64
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run build && npm run stage:runtime:mac -- --python-arch arm64 && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run build && npm run stage:runtime:mac -- --python-arch x64 && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
